exact_sequence_sweep.note: human 14-3-3 gamma, many as dimer with a bound phosphopeptide in the amphipathic groove: 2B05 (pSer peptide, 2.55 A), 6A5S (TFEB motif, 2.10 A), 6FEL/6Y4K (CaMKK2 motifs), 6GKG (caspase-2), 7A6R (DAPK2), 6BYL (O-GlcNAc-Thr peptide)
